newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Monti nominated to run Argentine firm YPF.
newsitem.headline: Monti nominated to run Argentine firm YPF.

text.p: Roberto Monti has been nominated to the newly-created position of general manager at Argentine oil firm YPF SA, and would effectively take over the day-to-day running of the company now carried out by chairman of the board Nells Leon, YPF said Friday.
Monti's nomination, and others, will be presented to a general shareholders meeting in April for approval, said Martin Paez Allende, YPF's institutional relations vice president.
Monti is currently president of YPF's U.S. subsidiary Maxus Energy Corp.
Current executive vice-president Miguel Madanes will be put forward to replace Leon as chairman of the board. Monti will also be nominated to replace Madanes as executive vice president.
YPF said Thursday that Leon has submitted his resignation as of April 1997 and that the board has decided to propose his successors to a shareholders meeting in April.
The company did not give reasons for Leon's resignation.
